Appreciate the template and the clear asks. Quick summary from our side:

- Pass-through of listing fees: operationally OK but we need to confirm invoicing path (CloudBridge -> end-customer vs CloudBridge -> Redwood -> end-customer). - Liability carveout: we can accept a limited pass-through liability for fees/taxes, but we cannot accept broad indemnities tied to marketplace billing errors.

I've looped in Karthik for legal redline guidance and Ben for marketplace ops acceptance and to coordinate the listing checklist. Proposed approach:

1) Karthik to provide redline markup and short summary of must-have changes by next Tue (7/6).
2) Ben to confirm whether CloudBridge invoicing model maps to our billing flows and surface any engineering/ops blockers by 7/8.
3) Irene to own final sign-off for marketplace readiness once legal and ops are aligned.

Thanks,

Team —

Quick legal read and proposed redline summary (attached redline PDF). High level recommendations:

- Pass-through fees: Acceptable if CloudBridge invoices customers directly. If invoice routing goes through Redwood, require a payment-forwarding SLA (net X days) and limited remedies for late remittance.
- Tax / withholdings: Add explicit clause that each party is responsible for its own tax remittances; CloudBridge must provide tax receipts for pass-throughed fees upon request.
- Liability cap: Do NOT accept open-ended liability for marketplace billing. Propose language capping liability to the fees actually paid in the prior 12 months and carve out gross negligence/intentional misconduct.
- Indemnity: Narrow indemnity to third-party IP claims and breaches of confidentiality; push back on indemnity tied to marketplace transaction disputes — request CloudBridge to indemnify for billing/process errors.
- Audit and records: Limited right to audit only for billing disputes and with 10 business days notice.

Attaching: RI_OrderForm_v2_clean.docx (our clean Order Form with proposed comment bubbles) and CloudBridge_Marketplace_Addendum_v3_redlines.pdf (annotated).

I will call out the non-starters in the attached PDF — please review and flag any commercial trade-offs you want me to relax (e.g., liability cap level).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
